# Dr. Abhijeet Holambe

> Dr. Abhijeet Holambe is a psychiatrist and sexologist in Malad West, Mumbai, with 6 years of clinical experience. He provides psychiatric, sexual health, and de-addiction consultations.

## Practice
- Website: https://www.drabhijeetholambe.com/
- Doctor: Dr. Abhijeet Holambe
- Role: Psychiatrist and Sexologist
- Qualifications: MBBS (Seth GS Medical College and KEM Hospital); MD Psychiatry (Grant Medical College and JJ Hospital, Mumbai)
- Experience: 6 years of clinical experience
- Clinic: Sun Multispeciality Hospital, Excel House, No. 6, B. J. Patel Road, opposite SNDT College, near Liberty Garden, Kanchpada, Malad West, Mumbai 400064
- Hours: 11:00 am to 4:00 pm, Monday to Sunday, by prior appointment
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 8169065210
- Email: drabhijeetholambe@gmail.com
- Languages: Hindi, Marathi, English
- Fees: First consultation ₹1,800; follow-up ₹1,500
- Google Maps: https://share.google/ZsC1gdVb6fxq6Vq69
- Practo: https://www.practo.com/mumbai/doctor/abhijeet-holambe-psychiatrist-1

## Areas of care
- Anxiety and panic symptoms
- Depression and mood concerns
- Sleep disorders
- Sexual health concerns
- Substance use and de-addiction
- Bipolar disorder
- Schizophrenia and psychosis
- OCD
- Neurodevelopmental concerns including ADHD and autism spectrum conditions
- Dementia and memory concerns
- Gender identity support
- Personality disorders
- Stress and burnout
- Productivity and focus concerns
- Relationship and couples counselling
- Adolescent mental health
- Online psychiatry consultations

## Workplace wellness
- Workshops on stress, burnout, and mental health at work.
- Workplace wellness workshop enquiries can be made on WhatsApp at +91 8169065210.
